name: @zerobias-org/product-nist-cmvp
description: The CMVP is the U.S. government program under NIST that validates cryptographic modules against FIPS 140-2/140-3, the standard federal law requires U.S. Government systems to use for cryptographic modules. Vendors submit modules for evaluation; NIST publishes the results, including certificate status, sunset date, and the specific caveats (e.g. required OS/software versions and configuration) under which each validation applies.
author: team@zerobias.com
